_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); personal-computer and consumer-electronics signals

pit_profile.why: Apple: it 'designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services', and has 'a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer and tablet markets' (its own FY2020 10-K, which gives no store count: 463 in the FY2015 10-K); its products and services 'are offered in highly competitive global markets characterized by aggressive price competition and resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Apple: it 'designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services', and has 'a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer and tablet markets' (its own FY2020 10-K, which gives no store count: 463 in the FY2015 10-K); its products and services 'are offered in highly competitive global markets characterized by aggressive price competition and resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 22.35x; +264% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.09; conservative 2yr -20%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.0%/yr (worst year FY11-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +58.2%/yr (Q2 FY21 sales + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +58.2%/yr (FY11-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +58.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AAPL (retrospective, 2021-04-30) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 22.35x (77.2% downside to Bear $30 / +3.5% upside to Bull $136) | Adj composite 2.45 vs market 3.54: gap -1.09 [OVERVALUED] | +264% above the EPP floor $36 (11x FY21E $3.28) | Conservative 2-yr case: -19.5% total (-9.8%/yr) | At 40.1x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $174 sits above the BULL case; Mac units not reported in Q2 FY21 (Mac net sales +70.1%), forward net sales +53.6% (no Q3 FY21 revenue guide, Q2 FY21 net sales); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
